title: THE BACKWARD DIGEST · The strip as its margin
venue: private · after the print tech's misfold of Sept 30, 1999 · Box 23 onward
logline: A page that is only the margin: the signature, the date, the mark, drawn at the size of a page, the letters and the two strokes of the gull filling the sheet, and inside the counters of the letters — the o's, the d's — tiny complete strips, twenty-three years of them, one per letter. The reader with a loupe gets the run; the reader without gets the mark.

panels.composition: A page filled by an enormous rendering of a comic strip's margin signature, date and two-stroke gull mark, and inside every enclosed letter counter a tiny complete four-panel strip drawn at loupe scale, each different.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a page filled with an enormous hand-lettered signature and date and a two-stroke gull mark, with tiny complete four-panel comic strips drawn inside every enclosed letter shape, no words legible at normal size
image.notes: The signature: A. Finch — Small Wood, OR, as shapes. The strips in the counters: reserved; twenty-three of them.

art.line: the private line, turned: mirrored, overlaid, folded
art.palette: the private washes; the 1997 xerox black where 1997 is quoted
art.paper: Arches; one page on a printed misfold
